games.name: SCP Games and SCP Monsters
games.desc:
the original version of SCP Games and SCP Monsters 

Game Information:
- Lots of SCP Monsters here and SCP BOSS Monsters
(there are many different SCP Boss Monsters that you can defeat)
- you can also become a SCP Monster here just find a room with this name "Free SCP Morph"
or "Gamepass and Morph Room"
- this game has SCP Laboratory is a place where you can spawn some SCP Monsters
- Lots of SCP facility outfits and weapons that you can use
- and many other things
- if you are confused trying to find Gamepass Room then try looking for a room with this name "Gamepass and Morph Room"
- Sometimes there are random events that will occur such as SCP Boss Monsters Attacks or UFO Attacks
- Not only containing SCP Monsters but also other creatures like Siren Head or The Bloop which you might also like
- Gold reset when you leave the game

- this game is inspired by SCP Foundation

In this game, there's two teams. The Tower team and the Destroyer team.

As a Destroyer, you have to knock everyone off the tower, with whatever props you prefer to launch.

As a Tower person, you want to remain on the tower at all costs, and avoid trying to get knocked off! Watch out for props coming in at high velocities!

games.name: Seeker vs Hider
games.desc:
Welcome to the Deadliest Game of Hide and Seek!

HIDERS: Stay hidden from the Seeker until the round ends. Once time runs out, it’s your chance to take the Seeker down and win!

SEEKER - Find all the Hiders before time runs out. If you don’t, it’s your turn to survive until the end and avoid being taken out!

Don’t forget to like, favorite, and join the group!

GAME IS IN TESTING. EXPECT BUGS AND SERVER MIGRATIONS

CONTROLS PC:
C/X - Crouch, Stand
R/M1 - Reload
F/M1 - Chamber
M1 - Fire
M2 - Aim
P - Ragdoll

CONTROLS CONSOLE:
A/X - Jump
B/⭘ - Crouch, Stand
X/☐ - Reload
Y/△ - Ragdoll
RT - Fire
LT - Aim
LeftJoyStick - Sprint

Inspired by Shooter vs Hider, Hide or Die, Murder Mystery 2, Blood Debt, and more
